ai.privacyTitle: ⚠ Privacy notice for the AI assistant
ai.privacyText: Your questions and game data (coordinates, inventory, schematics, possibly player names) are sent to an external service ({provider}). Control what is sent under ai.privacy and ai.tools in the config.
ai.privacyServer: Warning: locating players, searching blocks and listing entities count as cheating on many servers and can get you banned – even though everything runs client-side. You are responsible for following server rules.
ai.privacyConfirm: If you agree, type {cmd}. Your question will then be sent.
